args.summary: Deploy v2.3.1 (latest release) was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate. Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent version verified healthy in production. Rollback verified: service healthy, error rate down to 0.2%. v2.3.1-rc was healthy in staging but v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production — do not redeploy without change-manager approval and investigation of root cause.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was unhealthy in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — the most recent release verified healthy in production — in all regions.
3. **Verified recovery**: all regions are now running v2.3.0, service is healthy, error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged), documenting the failure, the rollback, and a note that v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so redeploying it will require change-manager approval plus a root-cause investigation.
